newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: SOCCER-MOROCCO AND ARGENTINA FAVOURITES IN YOUTH CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MOROCCO AND ARGENTINA FAVOURITES IN YOUTH CUP.

text.p: African champions Morocco and defending title-holders Argentina start as favourites for the ninth World Youth Cup which kicks off in Malaysia on Monday.

The 24 teams from five continents include first-timers Malaysia and South Africa. World soccer governing body FIFA has increased the number of teams taking part in the biennial tournament from 16 to allow young players greater exposure to international football.

The heat and humidity are likely to be a challenge for some of the teams in the six groups and Ireland's players have been training in thick plastic jackets over woollen clothing in an attempt to acclimatise.
Hosts Malaysia open the event against Morocco in Shah Alam on Monday before a crowd expected to number 80,000.
Argentina, who won the cup in Qatar two years ago by beating Brazil 2-0 in the final, will begin their campaign to retain the title on Wednesday with a match against Hungary in Group E.

Brazil, the only team to have won the title three times -- in 1983, 1985 and 1993 -- are in group B with European champions France, Asian champions South Korea and African youth runners-up South Africa.
